ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial Distric sysmbols and indications
as shown on Map No.1-K in the area bounded by

A line 100 feet South of and parallel to West Huron Street; the alley next east of and parallel to
North Cicero Avenue; a line 150 feet south of and parallel to West Huron Street; And North Cicero

Avenue,
to those of a C2-1, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 645-647 N. Cicero Avenue Chicago. IL 60644
